variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one exceptionally polished, high-resolution design presentation image for the existing Brazilian B2B industrial and maritime training website GRUPO SETEC SERVICE & TRAINING. This is a PREVIEW ONLY, not implementation. Apple website editorial craft and Apple Liquid Glass optical navigation are the requested inspiration. Preserve SETEC brand: deep navy #0E2334, brand blue #1F4E79, sparing copper #B46E3C, soft pearl #F3F4F6. No Apple logo. Use only existing Portuguese website copy given below, verbatim; do not invent marketing claims, statistics, customer logos, product data, slogans or pricing. Font is a refined clean sans serif similar to Outfit, premium calm hierarchy, generous whitespace. The supplied GS symbol is the existing logo; reproduce it faithfully without redesign or deformation alongside the exact brand text GRUPO SETEC and SERVICE & TRAINING. Images 2 and 3 are existing SETEC facility photos: use them faithfully as photographic inserts/crops, do not invent different facilities. Portrait photo should not be stretched.
Composition: 3:2 landscape artboard, crisp straight-on UI presentation, not a photograph of devices, no perspective, no glossy laptop mockup. Large desktop website hero viewport occupies about 72% of width on left. Narrow mobile website viewport occupies 24% on right, using same design language. Beneath left desktop viewport include a shallow secondary screen crop of course catalogue so direction extends beyond hero. Small external artboard title at top identifies option. No tiny annotation paragraphs. Screens should look implementable on the web, understated sophisticated and human, not a generic SaaS dashboard.
Hero exact copy: "Estrutura completa e excelência técnica que transformam operações industriais e marítimas". Subtitle exact: "Treinamentos práticos em equipamentos reais, operações de campo especializadas com equipes IRATA e locação de mão de obra qualificada." CTA exact "Conhecer Infraestrutura ↓". You may reflow lines but do not rewrite or truncate these strings. Logo in top left. Simple top utility links "Quem Somos", "Plataforma", "Treinamentos". Bottom navigation is the visual centerpiece: floating glass capsule, rounded continuous corners, visible softly blurred photographic/content colors behind it, subtle bright refractive edge, inner light, delicate broad shadow, restrained realistic Liquid Glass. It is a distinct control layer floating 20px above viewport bottom, NOT a dock of colorful application icons. Four evenly spaced line icons with ALWAYS VISIBLE labels: "Início", "Serviços", "Cursos NR", "Contato". Active item lightly tinted copper with navy or white readable foreground as appropriate. No overlapping content, no CTA hidden behind dock. Generous padding.
Catalogue crop exact title "Cursos de NRs Completos". Filter labels "Geral & Gestão", "Instalações & Máquinas", "Alto Risco", "Setoriais & Naval". Selected "Alto Risco". Three tidy solid-surface cards with labels "NR-20" / "Inflamáveis e Combustíveis", "NR-33" / "Espaços Confinados", "NR-35" / "Trabalho em Altura". No extra invented body copy. Bottom of crop may cut before more content; this is a viewport excerpt not entire site.
Mobile should show same hero full headline, compact complete subtitle, CTA, one crop of existing photo, and four-item glass dock at bottom. Keep type readable, comfortable touch targets. All body/card surfaces should be solid or near-solid; reserve true glass for navigation. Avoid neon turquoise, orange glow, giant empty space, gradients everywhere, rainbow icons, gratuitous decorative orbs, unreadable grey text, invented content, rewritten logo, Apple branding.
External title: '01 — Claro editorial'. Pearl white page canvas, navy large 56px equivalent headline centered above a wide panoramic crop of the glass training building. Copper only on small accents and CTA which has dark contrasting label. Ultra-clean white editorial product-page rhythm. Photo begins below hero text and behind glass dock so dock material is obvious. Mobile white, navy type, image below text. Catalogue white on pale gray with navy text. Hero feels like a premium architecture and industrial training institution.
